changelog.body:
https://github.com/kaduvert/AClipBoardManager/releases/tag/1.3.1

## Which version to pick?

- **AClipBoardManager-Xposed-legacy.apk**: uses Xposed 93, most widely compatible, use this if you want to be safe
- **AClipBoardManager.apk**: uses libxposed 102, compatible with cutting edge LSPosed setups

### IMPORTANT: If you've already installed it, don't update.

**This release has a different signature than the previous ones because it's [built  on GitLab Actions CI](https://gitlab.com/fdroid/fdroiddata/-/merge_requests/41952/pipelines)**.
The changes are minor and it's not worth it to reinstall to get them.
**If you still want to update, use [Core Patch N](https://modules.lsposed.org/module/org.lsposed.corepatch/)** to ignore signature conflict issues.

## Also, if you can:

**make a screen recording of this app working for you and post it to [the F-Droid MR](https://gitlab.com/fdroid/fdroiddata/-/merge_requests/41952), it will make it get accepted into F-Droid i think**
One person is enough though, so just chill out, someone probably did it already

Look at [v1.3.1](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.clipvault.app/releases/tag/5-1.3) if you haven't installed it yet.
e.g. you're not updating from a previous version

else just stick with this (v1.1.1)

https://github.com/kaduvert/AClipBoardManager/releases/tag/1.1.1

https://github.com/kaduvert/AClipBoardManager/releases/tag/1.1.0

**app-release.apk** uses **Xposed v82** i think, so that **works everywhere**

**app-release-Xposed-102-UNTESTED.apk**: if you have a device that uses **Xposed v102** you can try that version but i didn't test it so **you'd be the tester**.
**Go with app-release.apk for a tested, no-surprises experience** (on A15 at least)
